info.name: Star Therapeutics Content Custom Types API

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: faq_category
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific faq_category terms.

params.name: faq_category_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific faq_category terms.

items.docs: Lists items of the `avada_faq` custom post type registered by the Avada theme. Anonymously reachable but empty on this deployment (`X-WP-Total: 0`).
